content.short: Clanity is a Cardano rewards and engagement project connecting businesses, customers, and local contributors.
content.description: Clanity is a Cardano project focused on rewards, engagement, and community participation around local businesses. It aims to connect businesses with customers by using blockchain incentives to reward people who contribute reviews, feedback, promotion, or other forms of support. The project presents its token as a utility layer for a self-sustaining network where non-technical users can participate without facing complicated crypto workflows. Clanity's role is to turn everyday business engagement into measurable on-chain participation.
